Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address The Store Keeper, Examination Store, University of Kerala, Senate House Campus, Palayam, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. . 3. Warranty Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period: After having been notified of the defects

/ service requirement during warranty period, Seller has to complete the required Service / Rectification within 3 days time limit. Payment will be made only after the supply and installation of the items at our site. 6. Bidders who are blacklisted by State / Central Government departments and organizations are not eligib le to participate in this bid and such bids will be summarily rejected. A self-declaration of the bidder showi ng that the bidder is not blacklisted in India/Abroad for the last seven years (In company letter head) is to b e submitted. 7. Actual delivery is to be done at following address: The Store Keeper, General Store, University of Kerala, Senate House Campus, Palayam, Thiruvananthapuram. 8. If the selected bidder fails to complete the task within the delivery period prescribed above, the delayed consignment will be subject to 2% penalty per consignment per month or part thereof recoverable on the value of stores supplied. 9. The unexcused delay in the completion of task by the selected bidder in the prescribed delivery period o r If the selected bidder fails to supply and install the items after placing the Work Order/Supply Order, may render him liable to any or all of the following penalties: - (a) Incident will be reported through GeM Portal (b) The penalty as mentioned in this Bid document (c) Black listing or debarring from participating in any bid released by Kerala Government in future. 10. The rate quoted should be inclusive of all charges such as GST, delivery charges, packing, forwarding, freight, loading/unloading/handling and Government duties leviable, if any. 11. The Technical Evaluation Process will be carried out as per the specification/Compliance Statement att ached in the Buyer uploaded ATC Document. 12. The Duly filled signed and sealed Technical Compliance Statement should be submitted as per the for m attached in the Buyer uploaded ATC Document. 13. The Full payment will be made only after successful completion of the supply of the items at the propo sed site mentioned in the Supply Order and advance payment will not be allowed under any circumstances . No part payments shall be made. 14. The Bid inviting authority reserves the right to reject any bid, if the bidder does not meet the eligibility criteria/does not submit the document, mentioned in the Bid Document. 15.
